name: Solomon Islands
summary: A thin yellow diagonal band dividing a blue upper-hoist triangle with five white stars from a green lower-fly triangle. Adopted in 1977, a year before independence from Britain.
origin: The flag was adopted on 18 November 1977, ahead of independence on 7 July 1978. The five stars originally stood for the five districts of the protectorate.

colors.name: Blue
colors.meaning: Water: the ocean, rivers and rain.

symbols.name: Five stars
symbols.description: Five white stars in the blue triangle.
symbols.meaning: Originally the five districts; now the main island groups.

facts: The country now has nine provinces, but the flag keeps five stars.
Guadalcanal, the largest island, was the site of a major Second World War campaign.
Its thin yellow diagonal is one of the narrowest bands on a national flag.
clues: A thin yellow diagonal between blue with five white stars and green.
Its stars stood for five districts, though there are now nine provinces.
Adopted a year before independence in 1978.
